# Nuraan Perfumes

> Artisanal Concentrated Perfume Oils & Pure Attars | 100% Alcohol-Free | Handcrafted in India

Nuraan Perfumes is an Indian luxury artisanal perfumery house specializing in 100% alcohol-free concentrated perfume oils (attars) housed in 12ml precision stainless-steel roll-on bottles and 6 × 3ml curated gift sets.

- **Website**: https://nuraanperfumes.in/
- **Direct Scent Links**: https://nuraanperfumes.in/#bayan, https://nuraanperfumes.in/#garnet-540
- **Google Business Profile (Maps)**: https://www.google.com/maps/place/Nuraan+Perfumes/data=!4m2!3m1!1s0x3be7c39092405663:0xb15275cbcba777f4
- **WhatsApp Concierge**: +91 85910 59608 (https://wa.me/918591059608)
- **Instagram**: @nuraan_perfumes (https://www.instagram.com/nuraan_perfumes)
- **Location**: Mumbai, India
- **Shipping**: Free express courier dispatch across serviceable PIN codes in India (typically dispatched within 24–48 business hours)

---

## Core Brand Pillars

1. **100% Alcohol-Free**: Formulated as concentrated perfume oils without drying ethanol. For external use only; patch test recommended for sensitive skin.
2. **Up to 14+ Hours Longevity***: Concentrated oils bind to pulse-point lipids and typically project for up to 14–24 hours on skin and longer on natural fabrics (*actual longevity varies with weather, humidity, body temperature, skin type, and application).
3. **12ml Precision Roll-On Single Bottles**: Fitted with smooth stainless-steel rollerballs for effortless, spill-free application on pulse points.
4. **Accessible Alternative Scent Profiles**: Nuraan crafts artisanal, pure-oil renditions inspired by globally admired scent DNAs (e.g. BR 540 / Baccarat Rouge 540, Aventus, Black Opium, Icon) at a fraction of luxury retail prices (saving shoppers 70% to 97%).
